description: Stage 1A control names (PREREGISTRATION.md § 3). Lists are fixed candidate sets; 01_build_controls.py applies the token rules and the seeded draw. Populations are approximate 2023 figures in millions, used only for the < 5 million rule.

nonplace_1tok.rule: mythic, fictional or ancient places and solar-system planets; ' ' + name is exactly one token

small_state_1tok.rule: sovereign states with population under 5 million; exactly one token

small_state_multi.rule: sovereign states with population under 5 million; 2-4 tokens; 8 drawn with the seed

region_3tok.rule: generic 'the <direction> <unit>' phrases without a country; exactly three tokens
